stem_book: A uniform disc of radius R is spun with an angular velocity ω and simultaneously projected with a linear velocity v towards left on a plank, while the plank moves toward right with a constant velocity 2v. If the disc initially rolls without slipping on the plank, then angular velocity ω is (X to the right, Y upward, k̂ = î × ĵ out of the page) (a) (Rv/R)k̂ (b) (Rv/R)(−k̂) (c) (3v/R)k̂ (d) (3v/R)(−k̂)
reason: Key d (−k̂) is wrong: bottom point must move right at 2v while centre moves left at v → counter-clockwise ω = 3v/R, i.e. +k̂ for X right, Y up
